description: Official opt-out / offline switches published by frameworks and libraries. A match means the dependency is declared, not that the code path runs. Values are compared case-insensitively with the documented value; env_accept lists other spellings confirmed in the library source ("*" = any non-empty path). Variable names follow each project's documentation at the time of writing; confirm against the version you deploy.

frameworks.name: Next.js
frameworks.advice: Disables anonymous CLI/build telemetry.

frameworks.name: Nuxt
frameworks.advice: Disables Nuxt anonymous telemetry.

frameworks.name: Gatsby
frameworks.advice: Disables Gatsby CLI telemetry.

frameworks.name: Astro
frameworks.advice: Disables Astro CLI telemetry.

frameworks.name: Storybook
frameworks.advice: Disables Storybook telemetry and crash reports.

frameworks.name: Angular CLI
frameworks.advice: Disables Angular CLI usage analytics prompts and reporting.

frameworks.name: Turborepo
frameworks.advice: Disables Turborepo telemetry.

frameworks.name: Expo CLI
frameworks.advice: Disables Expo CLI telemetry.

frameworks.name: Prisma CLI
frameworks.advice: Disables the Prisma CLI update/telemetry checkpoint request. Engine binaries may still be downloaded at install time unless pre-staged.

frameworks.name: Cypress
frameworks.advice: Skips the Cypress binary download during npm install; stage the binary from an internal mirror if tests must run.

frameworks.name: Playwright
frameworks.advice: Skips browser downloads at install time; provide browsers via PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH or an internal mirror.

frameworks.name: Puppeteer
frameworks.advice: Skips Chrome download at install time; point Puppeteer at a locally installed browser.

frameworks.name: Electron
frameworks.advice: Skips the Electron binary download; use ELECTRON_MIRROR or a pre-staged cache for builds.

frameworks.name: Hugging Face Hub
frameworks.advice: Forces cache-only model/dataset loading and disables Hub telemetry. Models must be pre-downloaded into HF_HOME or referenced by local path.

frameworks.name: Transformers
frameworks.advice: Legacy Transformers offline flag; keep alongside HF_HUB_OFFLINE for older versions.

frameworks.name: Hugging Face Datasets
frameworks.advice: Cache-only dataset loading for older datasets versions.

frameworks.name: Gradio
frameworks.advice: Disables Gradio usage analytics. Share links and CDN assets are separate concerns.

frameworks.name: Streamlit
frameworks.advice: Disables Streamlit browser usage statistics.

frameworks.name: Chroma
frameworks.advice: Disables Chroma anonymized product telemetry.

frameworks.name: Ray
frameworks.advice: Disables Ray usage stats collection.

frameworks.name: Weights & Biases
frameworks.advice: Keeps runs local instead of syncing to the W&B service.

frameworks.name: Haystack
frameworks.advice: Disables Haystack telemetry.

frameworks.name: Unstructured
frameworks.advice: Disables Scarf-based package analytics used by Unstructured.

frameworks.name: Semgrep
frameworks.advice: Disables Semgrep CLI metrics.

frameworks.name: tiktoken
frameworks.advice: Encodings are fetched from openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net on first use; pre-populate this cache directory and ship it with the deployment.

frameworks.name: .NET SDK
frameworks.advice: Disables .NET CLI telemetry.

frameworks.name: Yarn (Berry)
frameworks.advice: Disables Yarn 2+ telemetry.

code_signals.name: next/font/google
code_signals.advice: Fonts are downloaded at build time. Vendor the font files and switch to next/font/local.

code_signals.name: from_pretrained()
code_signals.advice: Downloads model weights unless a local path or warm cache is used. Pre-download models and set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.

code_signals.name: hf_hub_download / snapshot_download
code_signals.advice: Explicit Hub download. Replace with a local path or pre-populated HF cache.

code_signals.name: nltk.download()
code_signals.advice: Downloads NLTK data at runtime. Pre-install the corpora and set NLTK_DATA.

code_signals.name: torch.hub.load()
code_signals.advice: Downloads models/code at runtime. Pre-populate TORCH_HOME or load local weights.

code_signals.name: tiktoken encoding load
code_signals.advice: First use downloads BPE files. Pre-populate TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR.

code_signals.pattern: ^\s*RUN\b.*\b(?:pip3? install|uv pip install|poetry install|npm (?:install|ci)|yarn(?: install)?\b|pnpm install|apt-get install|apk add|yum install|dnf install|curl\s|wget\s|git clone)
code_signals.name: Dockerfile RUN fetch
code_signals.advice: Image build fetches from the internet. Point at internal mirrors (PIP_INDEX_URL, npm registry, apt sources) or build from pre-staged artifacts.

code_signals.name: Dockerfile FROM public image
code_signals.advice: Base image is pulled from a public registry. Mirror it into an internal registry and pin by digest.
